wintercity_e10_entry.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_entry.text: Day 878 began in the inn's less flexible shared room. Yue had paid eight copper for the week through Day 884 and accepted its seven-day notice requirement. The window was smaller, but the bed stood away from the outer wall. She arranged her trunk with the other occupants so no one had to climb over it in the dark. The lower price had an actual benefit and an actual exit cost. She could not carry the cheaper receipt into another room and demand identical terms.

wintercity_e10_002.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_002.text: At the square, the final comparative station stood under a temporary roof. Its central bar joined two independently grounded participant arms through an ordinary mechanical linkage. The connection would transmit counterforce, not send one person's qi into the other's channels. Each participant's input would be measured in the permitted range for that practitioner. The greater Foundation capacity and the small circuit could therefore meet in a direct bounded contest without pretending their bodies had the same safe flow.

wintercity_e10_003.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_003.text: Yan checked the ordinary isolation and mechanical travel limits. Luo Pei inspected the independent measurements, declared ranges, and clear side runout. The event's clinic attendant checked the approach to the ordinary examination chair. Zhou An would review injuries through the clinic's existing service route if further care was needed. These preparations did not wait for somebody to be hurt. They made a consented comparison possible while leaving a contestant responsible to release before her own strain or balance made the permitted task unsafe for her.

wintercity_e10_004.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_004.text: Yue read the public warning beside the participant form. A declared safe qi input did not make tendons invulnerable to ordinary counterforce. The contestant could release and step back. A release would record a loss if the other person remained in the winning position. It would not cancel unrelated earned wages or justify a private source confiscation. She understood those words. The more difficult question was whether she would remember them while a crowd watched her try to hold a mark.

wintercity_e10_005.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_005.text: Gao Shen's public statement called the station an answer to exaggerated claims about small operators. Some room buyers had heard that any person who could guide a signal could keep a heating service running. His comparison would show why actual capacity mattered. Yue agreed that the exaggerated claim was false. She objected when a listener treated the same statement as an answer to whether a provider owed proper notice, staffed alternatives, or fair employment terms. Those obligations did not depend on her arm defeating the owner.

wintercity_e10_006.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_006.text: She asked for that distinction during the public questions. Gao Shen replied that a contract could not warm a room without power. Yue said a powerful works could still close a room to a person whose eligibility had been misclassified. Neither statement erased the other. The crowd wanted a sharper argument. Luo Pei said the station would measure the counter-movement result only. Any service or contract claim would need its own proper forum and evidence. She would not let the apparatus announce a verdict it had not examined.

wintercity_e10_007.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_007.text: An onlooker asked Yue whether she would prove her point by competing. She could have left the question there, explaining that the points differed. Instead she heard an old familiar suspicion: careful words from somebody unable to do real work. Her earlier years at the kiln and recruitment terrace seemed briefly crowded into that voice. It was not fair to attribute all that history to this stranger. It was still powerful enough that she asked to see the small-circuit participant application.

wintercity_e10_008.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_008.text: The application offered no path to a new realm. It would examine a direct permitted counter-movement, its actual useful support, and a controlled release under the inspected station's conditions. Gao Shen's larger capacity was declared and qualified for his own range. Yue's ceiling remained the established half-unit over four ordinary breaths, no greater than one eighth per breath, with a lower setting if the recovered check required it. Any new symptom would stop admission. A public desire to be seen would not alter the examiner's conditions.

wintercity_e10_009.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_009.text: Luo Pei asked why Yue wanted to apply. Yue first said she wanted people to respect the source records. The examiner said those records would not become truer because Yue held a bar. Yue then admitted she wanted to know whether she could hold her own permitted movement clearly enough that an audience saw more than a hesitant clerk. Luo Pei accepted the honest answer as a reason to consider the application, not as proof that it was a wise one. The result could still be a straightforward loss.

wintercity_e10_010.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_010.text: Yue returned to her actual job after the public interval, keeping the participant question outside its paid hours. A factory appointment and a public copying appointment did not require competitive performance. She would not alter a source count because she felt slighted in the square, or use an employer's name to make a personal application appear mandatory. She worked the scheduled morning's actual task and took its reviewed copy. The afternoon remained governed by the accepted job's own observation or free-time conditions.

wintercity_e10_011.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_011.text: On Day 879, the short factory trial or public office appointment reached its stated final morning, while the full factory term continued. Yue brought the actual current job receipt to the proper desk. Missing or unclear records could not authorize private source access or manufacture a payment from an unaccepted offer. She asked that any completed hours and remaining custody be identified precisely. The accepted employment choice had supplied different work, and its pay clocks would now expose a practical part of that difference.

wintercity_e10_012.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_012.text: The applicable desk recorded the work actually completed and the term still in force or ended. Yue retained the signed receipt and returned whatever source belonged to that day's closure. A finished short job would not renew by habit. A continuing full job would still require the next mornings. She kept the two possibilities distinct before walking to lunch. A stage title could not pay rent; a future wage could not become current money merely because she knew its possible total.

wintercity_e10_013.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_013.text: At the noodle stall, Wen listened to the contest question and stopped peeling her bun. She asked whether Yue expected to win. Yue said she knew Gao Shen had greater capacity. Wen asked what she hoped to gain by losing in front of a crowd. Yue said a measured account and perhaps a clearer view of her own limits. Wen said that might be useful, and the desire to silence a stranger sounded like a separate reason that could make the useful one dangerous.

wintercity_e10_014.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_014.text: Yue disliked hearing it phrased so plainly. She thought of the long years in which people had treated her work as proof that she should be satisfied without cultivation. Wen had not been there for all those years. Yet Wen did know when a friend skipped supper to reread a public notice. Yue said she would use the station's release and accept the result. Wen asked her to say the same thing to the examiner, who could write it into the actual conditions rather than leave it as a brave promise over food.

wintercity_e10_015.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_015.text: They finished their meal without resolving the emotional question. Wen had a handle delivery; Yue had the application to inspect. Their routes divided at the fruit-tree path. Yue did not turn her friend's concern into discouragement from someone who failed to understand cultivation. Wen could understand enough about ordinary bodies and pride to ask a useful question. She could also remain a friend who wanted to see a fox-painted umbrella finished, not spend every free evening watching a bar decide Yue's reputation.

wintercity_e10_016.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_016.text: In the afternoon, Yue visited Min Tuan's yard and paid two copper for a third ordinary lesson. Tuan asked her to practise releasing a padded board rather than resisting until he pulled it away. The first time, she waited for his voice. He said a voice could be late in a noisy public room. She tried again, noticing her own heel's position and the edge of the pad. The lesson ended without qi and without the satisfying fiction that she could now retreat perfectly under any pressure.

wintercity_e10_017.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_017.text: Tuan said people sometimes imagined that a safe path obliged them to stay until it became necessary. He preferred a retreat taken while it was still easy. Yue asked whether that would look timid. He said it might. The yard could teach a movement, not control a spectator's judgement. She left with that blunt distinction and a little soreness from ordinary exercise, which she reported on the next recovered check rather than conceal because it came from an unspiritual task.

wintercity_e10_018.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_018.text: On Day 880, the first full factory week reached its payment day, while the shorter employment terms had already ended after their actual last morning. Yue checked the applicable wage and custody receipts before setting any money aside. The full, trial, and public options did not yield the same total, source access, or remaining duties. No payment from an unchosen vacancy would arrive because the alternative still looked attractive on an old offer sheet. She took the record to the desk where her work had actually been done.

wintercity_e10_019.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_019.text: After the job account was checked, Yue counted only money actually received. Her thirty-two-copper travel purse remained separate. The cheaper inn interval reduced future room costs but did not erase the first weeks' payments. Family help already dispatched or not dispatched stayed recorded at its actual amount. She could afford the station's three-copper participant fee from current money. Paying it would fund her own application interval under the terms, with no guarantee of a win and no refund for a disappointed audience.

wintercity_e10_020.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_020.text: She submitted the direct counter-movement application that afternoon. The stated purpose was a bounded comparison, not a challenge to service law through strength. Luo Pei retained the right to refuse admission if the recovered check failed or the source conditions changed. Yan would handle the apparatus; Yue would supply only the permitted personal movement and release. Gao Shen's actual range remained greater. Yue signed knowing the likely physical result and still wanting to complete the attempt for reasons she could not entirely make admirable.

wintercity_e10_021.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_021.text: The participant fee was three copper, paid with a receipt. It did not buy a private practice cylinder or a right to operate the station alone. The event's external instrument supply and ordinary first-aid interval belonged to the separate approved event fund. Personal input would be accounted independently. The apparatus would limit travel and provide grounded release, but it could not guarantee no ordinary bruise or strain. Yue read the limits aloud to Luo Pei before the application was accepted for inspection.

wintercity_e10_022.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_022.text: The examiner asked her to state the winning condition. Yue said the other participant would win when she released or crossed the declared mark under the inspected procedure, if his result remained valid. She did not add that a smaller stage deserved a second winning condition for moral seriousness. Luo Pei wrote the answer. A fair record could protect the meaning of the comparison; it could not equalize capacities or make the participant proud of every possible outcome.

wintercity_e10_023.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_023.text: Gao Shen received notice of the accepted application. He met Yue at the public board, without an employee supervisor present. He asked whether she understood that their conversation about contract terms would not be decided at the station. She said she did. He said he would use his declared tested range, not weaken the result to flatter her. She preferred that honesty to a staged compliment, though it made the likely loss more vivid. Neither promised the other an outcome beyond the actual rules.

wintercity_e10_024.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_024.text: He also said he would not ask the works to penalize unrelated completed clerical work because she lost a public comparison. The employment terms already said so. Yue replied that a public statement could be useful alongside the clause, but the actual wage receipts would still matter. Gao Shen nodded. She did not gain immunity from future ordinary errors or custody duties. She gained a clear distinction between the competitive result and another obligation, spoken before either could be conveniently blended after defeat.

wintercity_e10_025.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_025.text: On Day 881, the streets carried festival rehearsal sounds before evening. The music student played a paid short interval near the paper seller. Yue listened from the public edge and bought no additional performance time. He had a private practice booking afterward and could not remain because she liked the tune. His audition journey was still uncertain. She wished him a safe route and noticed how much easier it was to respect another person's fixed closing time than her own wish to keep one promising moment going.

wintercity_e10_026.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_026.text: At the inn, Jia said the revised fourth-shop trial would continue for another finite interval. The owner accepted a later collection time and the cap on returns. That agreement was a modest institutional concession earned by actual delivery figures and a worker's refusal to keep waiting without a change. It did not require Jia to win a contest against the owner's strongest porter. Yue laughed at the comparison and then fell quiet. Jia had not meant to mock her; the difference was still useful enough to sting.

wintercity_e10_027.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_027.text: Yue spent the afternoon on ordinary source-labelled preparation. The direct station's public diagram showed the mechanical linkage and safe exit path. It did not contain Gao Shen's private cultivation method. She could understand the contest conditions without owning that method or assuming the Foundation input came from an external cylinder through his body. His qualified liquid reservoir and route control were his; the apparatus had its own compatible supply for measurement. Each source would remain distinct in the actual record.

wintercity_e10_028.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_028.text: Yan showed her the uncharged participant arm during the public permitted interval. Yue set her hands where the inspector specified and found the release without adding qi. The station differed from the earlier signal rig. Her certificate or observation from that rig did not automatically certify the new movement. Luo Pei would inspect it separately against her established route and current recovered condition. Careful previous work could help her learn, while the changed task still demanded an actual fresh check.

wintercity_e10_029.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_029.text: When Yan applied a gentle ordinary demonstration load to the uncharged arm, Yue felt how quickly a clenched grip could make the wrist awkward. She opened her hand and released. The point was not to prove strength today. It was to know which ordinary posture could add strain even while qi input stayed inside a nominal ceiling. She asked for the grip instruction on her own participant sheet. Yan added it as a practical preparation note, with no promise that its presence would compel Yue's body to obey under pressure.

wintercity_e10_030.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_030.text: At the public board on Day 881, Gao Shen stood close enough for Yue to notice the grey at his temples. He was fifty-two, tall and broad through the shoulders, with a neatly trimmed beard and weathered tan skin. His charcoal-indigo outer robe lay over a slate work tunic, fastened by a polished copper clasp. Nothing in the plain arrangement looked careless. Wealth could choose simplicity as deliberately as a poorer traveller chose an affordable cloth.

wintercity_e10_031.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_031.text: He held the certified station conditions with bare practical hands, asking the service manager about the declared ranges. His joined Foundation had been qualified through its own established tests; it was not a title the coming event would grant him. Yue could respect the physical competence without accepting every argument he made about employment. The difference would need to survive the public result. A stronger person might win a direct contest and still answer an ordinary source or notice question afterward.

wintercity_e10_032.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_032.text: Gao Shen asked whether the immediate participant check included grip and sensation. Luo Pei confirmed it did, with a lower range or refusal where current condition required. He said he would accept her decision for either participant. Yue appreciated the public commitment and did not mistake it for tenderness. A reliable event suited the owner's demonstration too. Their interests overlapped in wanting a defensible physical result, while their disputes about service terms remained beyond what the central bar could establish.

wintercity_e10_033.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_033.text: When the manager offered to place Yue's employee status on the display notice, Gao Shen told him to use only her actual public participant particulars. Employment, where accepted, belonged to its separate file. Yue asked that the same distinction apply to a nonemployee or former trial worker, and Luo Pei confirmed it. A clear label could prevent one rumour. It could not control every spectator's memory, so the source-labelled record would still matter after an exciting attempt.

wintercity_e10_034.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_034.text: On Day 882, Wen brought the fox-handled umbrella to its client while Yue waited outside the shop. The child who owned it tested the grip and wanted the painted tail turned slightly inward. Wen adjusted the removable wrap with permission, keeping the useful grip clear. The child's mother paid the remaining agreed balance. The completed object had changed through several preferences, rather than satisfy an artisan's first idea at the expense of the person who would carry it.

wintercity_e10_035.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_035.text: Yue asked the child whether she liked the fox. The child wanted to know whether it could bite the rain. Yue said the cloth would keep the rain off her head if used properly, and the fox was paint. The child accepted that answer and made a biting sound herself. Play needed no false technique to remain lively. Wen laughed, and for several minutes the public contest's measured range felt distant beside an ordinary umbrella that had finally found its owner.

wintercity_e10_036.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_036.text: That evening, Yue hung her robe where its repaired seam would dry after washing. She checked the collar knot and folded the public participant paper away from the private job cover. The separation was becoming a habit, useful while her mind kept returning to the central bar. A habit could support a difficult choice; it could not make her immune to pride. She wanted the next morning's work and a friend's small completed repair to retain their proper weight, even as the coming public attempt grew louder in her thoughts.

wintercity_e10_037.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_037.text: On Day 882, her ordinary exercise soreness had resolved and the recovered check showed normal touch and grip. Luo Pei accepted the personal route conditions for the declared lower range, with the ceiling unchanged. The examiner would repeat the immediate check before the actual contest on Day 888. Admission today was conditional on that future condition. Yue had no permission to ignore a later symptom because she had already paid three copper or told a friend she intended to compete.

wintercity_e10_038.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_038.text: The accepted employment still determined which work and observation, if any, occupied that day. Private bench sources stayed private; public work stayed with public references. Yue would not use an interesting method glimpse as evidence that she could produce the owner's greater counterforce. The private appointment concerned records, not the admission of a new realm. She kept the job's particular report separate from her personal contest sheet. Pride was capable of mixing them faster than a careless clerk's misplaced cover.

wintercity_e10_039.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_039.text: Rao Jun saw the public application notice and asked whether she had volunteered. Yue said yes. He told her he would be working during most of the event and might hear the result later. She did not ask him to lose paid time to witness her dignity. Jun wished her a sensible release and returned to the customer's window. The city would continue its ordinary tasks while two cultivators compared force. Knowing that did not make the contest meaningless; it made it smaller than the whole winter.

wintercity_e10_040.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_040.text: That evening, Wen completed the fox-painted umbrella with the client's permission for a public display. Yue came to look. The fox's tail curled around the ordinary handle without interfering with its grip. Wen wanted that detail appreciated, and Yue gave it her full attention for several minutes. She could do that much for a friend. The contest diagram stayed folded in her pocket. Cultivation had not entitled it to occupy every table where somebody else had made a good useful thing.

wintercity_e10_041.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_041.text: On Day 883, Ning offered a two-hour paid notice task for the following afternoon, worth four copper after completion. Yue would need to choose how it fit with her final contest preparation. The task's source copies were ready and another qualified copier could take it if she declined. The choice would be an actual lost or earned payment, not a symbolic test of whether she cared about work. She compared it with the preparation options that the public station could properly offer.

wintercity_e10_042.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_042.text: One option was an extra measured orientation with Yan under the permitted uncharged conditions, costing four copper for the additional staff interval. Another was to keep the afternoon quiet, use ordinary rest, and decline the paid copying task without claiming its wage. A third was a source-and-witness preparation: a one-copper certified public diagram and a two-copper neutral record clerk for her bounded attempt. Each would prepare a different practical part of the same entered contest. None would raise her stage or cancel Gao Shen's greater tested range.

wintercity_e10_043.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_043.text: Yue asked Wen whether she wanted to witness the attempt. Wen said she could come for the single declared interval if her thumb and repair schedule allowed, but would not become the official score clerk or spend the whole day policing rumours. Yue thanked her for the limit. A friend could offer company without accepting a permanent role in somebody else's competitive ambition. The neutral clerk, if booked, would have a paid defined duty. The operator and examiner remained the pre-established event staff, not replacements summoned by friendship.

wintercity_e10_044.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_044.text: The last factory work-only bench observation, where applicable, would occur on Day 884. The short trial and public appointment had no such private access. Yue brought the actual source receipt to its proper desk before final preparation, so the employment scope could govern that afternoon honestly. She could not enter a private door on the public contest fee or use the owner’s invitation as a second factory pass. Different commitments still owned different hours, and the comparison would not dissolve them.

wintercity_e10_045.speaker: narrator
wintercity_e10_045.text: The actual observation or closed-job record was handled within those limits. Yue kept only permitted owned notes and signed the source return for any pages she had actually used. A full term still had paid mornings through Day 887; the shorter appointments stayed ended. Today's private observation, if any, would not reopen them or provide a general personal practice bench. The employment source rules would survive whatever she did at the public station, because an apparatus loss could not transfer someone else's property.

wintercity_contest_preparation_choice.speaker: narrator
wintercity_contest_preparation_choice.text: On Day 884, she considered the last preparation route for the entered contest. A measured orientation would spend four copper and provide extra concrete posture checks. A quiet rest interval would preserve that fee while sacrificing the four-copper copying opportunity. A source-and-witness route would buy its actual public record work and leave the extra posture session unperformed. Each route would lead to the same declared comparison with the stronger cultivator, carrying its own preparation, missing work, and practical consequences into the attempt.

choices.text: Pay for extra measured posture preparation and forgo the copying wage.
Use ordinary rest, without the extra session or the copying wage.
Buy the bounded public source and neutral witness record, without extra posture work.

wintercity_employment_clock_factory_001.speaker: narrator
wintercity_employment_clock_factory_001.text: The full factory term continued after Day 879. Yue had completed six four-hour mornings so far, giving twenty-four hours awaiting the first weekly payment. The next morning would complete the seven-day week. She returned that day's source packet to the cupboard and signed its inventory. The pass still allowed the accepted internal desk and the remaining work-only observations through their actual dates. It did not authorize a personal contest practice inside the factory or let her remove a private method page.

wintercity_employment_clock_factory_002.speaker: narrator
wintercity_employment_clock_factory_002.text: The supervisor marked the reviewed hours without describing the next eight mornings as already worked. Yue retained the current tally and went to lunch. The larger promised total had a real remaining condition: she still needed to complete the term or settle an actual earlier exit. Her public application would be made outside work, with no right to turn an employee's pass into a contestant's source.

wintercity_employment_clock_probation_00.speaker: narrator
wintercity_employment_clock_probation_00.text: At the end of Day 879's trial morning, Yue returned all six permitted public-stock comparison sheets. The supervisor checked the inventory and the twenty-four completed hours, then paid forty-eight copper. She counted it and received the wage receipt. The trial pass expired at its stated end. No private bench access had ever been included, and no report from such an observation could be claimed now. The limited job closed with its actual source and money duties fulfilled.

wintercity_employment_clock_probation_00.speaker: narrator
wintercity_employment_clock_probation_00.text: The supervisor asked whether she wanted another offer later. Yue said she would read one if it arrived, making no present commitment. She had no unpaid seventh morning and no lost permanent post. The shorter term had left more free afternoons and less pay than the full offer. Its completed work remained useful without quietly acquiring the access she had chosen to forgo.

wintercity_employment_clock_public_001.speaker: narrator
wintercity_employment_clock_public_001.text: Ning checked the public job's six completed three-hour mornings on Day 879. Eighteen hours at the agreed rate produced thirty-six copper, paid in front of Yue with a signed receipt. The source copies returned to their tray, and the finite office appointment ended. Yue could still read public notices as an ordinary visitor. She had no ongoing paid desk, factory pass, or private method appointment to extend by habit. The lower-income alternative had supplied actual public work and its actual payment.

wintercity_employment_clock_public_002.speaker: narrator
wintercity_employment_clock_public_002.text: Another qualified clerk would handle the next funded copying interval. Yue did not have to make the office dependent on her to value what she had done. She carried her owned reviewed pages and left the office source originals behind. The completed public term kept afternoons available and denied the private work access that had belonged to the unchosen factory appointments.

wintercity_employment_pay_factory_001.speaker: narrator
wintercity_employment_pay_factory_001.text: On Day 880, the seventh full-term morning brought the first factory week to twenty-eight hours. The supervisor checked the reviewed pages and paid fifty-six copper. Yue counted the coins and signed only for that sum. Another fifty-six might become due after the seven remaining mornings through Day 887; it was not money in her purse today. The next internal source packet stayed under the same identified confidentiality and actual return rules. A weekly wage did not buy its ownership.

wintercity_employment_pay_factory_002.speaker: narrator
wintercity_employment_pay_factory_002.text: The afternoon's dated work-only bench observation proceeded under the qualified technician. Yue compared the permitted record and the uncharged housing, then returned the method page to its custodian. She introduced no personal qi. Her private observation could inform the accepted report, not a public teaching claim. The job still occupied particular mornings and afternoons while her own contest remained a separately funded application.

wintercity_employment_pay_probation_001.speaker: narrator
wintercity_employment_pay_probation_001.text: Yue's trial wage had already been paid on Day 879. On Day 880 she checked the forty-eight-copper receipt and made no new factory claim. The expired trial pass went back to the visitor office, which signed its return. There was no second week to add to the total and no private bench observation that afternoon. Her shorter commitment had become a concrete completed interval, with actual money available and particular further access unavailable.

wintercity_employment_pay_probation_002.speaker: narrator
wintercity_employment_pay_probation_002.text: She used the free afternoon to submit the personal contest form through its public route. The participant fee would be her own, not deducted invisibly from a factory stipend she had not accepted. A public application could proceed on its own conditions even after an employment term ended. That separation preserved her freedom without inventing either a new job or the larger wage she had declined.

wintercity_employment_pay_public_001.speaker: narrator
wintercity_employment_pay_public_001.text: On Day 880, Yue read the thirty-six-copper completed public-job receipt before setting money aside. No second office week had been offered or worked. Ning retained the returned source originals, while Yue's owned reviewed copy stayed hers. She had no factory pass to return because she had never received one. The private bench observation advertised for employees was not an appointment she could attend. That missing access remained part of the lower-income public alternative she had actually chosen.

wintercity_employment_pay_public_002.speaker: narrator
wintercity_employment_pay_public_002.text: Her free afternoon was available for the public contest application and its separate three-copper fee. She used no office authority to approve herself as a participant. Luo Pei would assess the task and recovered conditions independently. The completed public copying work made her better informed about notices, and none of it increased the safe personal throughput declared on the participant page.

wintercity_employment_lastbench_factory_.speaker: narrator
wintercity_employment_lastbench_factory_.text: On Day 884, Yue attended the sixth and final included work-only bench observation. The dates were complete: 874, 876, 878, 880, 882, and 884. Each had remained uncharged or operated by the qualified technician within the work's accepted scope. Yue returned the last private method page to the cupboard after checking its identifier. She retained only her permitted own report notes. Neither the private source nor the apparatus became hers because she had observed it carefully six times.

wintercity_employment_lastbench_factory_.speaker: narrator
wintercity_employment_lastbench_factory_.text: The fourteen-morning employment term still required Days 885, 886, and 887. Its second week's wage would follow actual completion. This last afternoon observation did not end the morning duties or grant a personal practice bench for tomorrow. Yue told the supervisor how her extra contest preparation would fit outside the accepted hours. A useful private job and a public comparison remained separate commitments, each with its own evidence and exit.

wintercity_employment_lastbench_probatio.speaker: narrator
wintercity_employment_lastbench_probatio.text: The short factory trial had no private bench appointment on Day 884. Yue checked its closed source inventory and paid forty-eight-copper receipt, then left the old offer sheet in her trunk. A supervisor's earlier visitor invitation was not an employee pass after the trial ended. She had no authority to enter the sixth observation offered only under the full term. The job's actual completion preserved its limited work without making the larger offer's benefit silently available.

wintercity_employment_lastbench_probatio.speaker: narrator
wintercity_employment_lastbench_probatio.text: She could spend the afternoon on her own entered contest preparation. Its public diagram and inspected participant arm belonged to a different permitted arrangement. She would still need the immediate recovered check on the actual contest day.
